decisions.reason: Automatic delivery of a winner's prize does not change the Small Block drawing, eligibility, ticket, funding, or winner-selection rules.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already replaces the relevant FAQ sections with direct wallet delivery and contains no obsolete claim-page attribute requiring removal.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already states that prize winnings are delivered directly to the wallet and accessed through dashboard and email guidance.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already states that prize wins are delivered automatically to the recipient's wallet, so no additional update or removal is needed.
Changing prize collection from one-click claim to automatic transfer does not alter the independently automatic $5 referral commission.
Automatic wallet delivery does not remove winner email notification or guidance for viewing or converting the received prize.
The prize collection method does not change which NFT state, referral identity, badges, or active and expired tickets transfer to a purchaser.
Automatic prize delivery does not change secondary-sale royalty enforcement, funding, ticket generation, or royalty allocation.
The source decision concerns collection of prize winnings and does not change allocation of the $5 commission for a mint without a referral code.
The prize collection method does not affect referral-code identity, permanence, or display locations.
Changing how a winner receives a prize does not change the established $15 primary-sale allocation.
The landing-page hero describes the prize opportunity but not its collection interaction, so replacing one-click claim with automatic transfer does not require a hero-state change.
